notes: Stats and career pages render from JSON data files on rady.ucsd.edu (/_resources/data/stats/ftmba-stats.json and /_resources/data/career/ftmba-career.json), fetched directly this session. GMAT edition is not labeled; entering Fall 2025 (Class of 2027) and the 645 median is consistent with the Focus scale, so it is recorded as Focus per protocol; the 627 mean is noted in stat. GRE published only as percentile means (Quant 63rd, Verbal 78th) and total mean 327, no scaled quant/verbal subscores. No acceptance rate published. Salary published only as average (116,430 for 2024 graduates), no median. Prior US News and Poets and Quants figures replaced or dropped in favor of official pages. Rady's current official stats page publishes no GMAT figure; the prior undated third-party GMAT was dropped.
